66: def scrub_outbound(text: Optional[str], owner_identifiers: Iterable[Optional[str]] = ()) -> Optional[str]:
67:     """Strip third-party identifiers from a message bound for the customer.
68: 
69:     The recipient's own email/phone survive — telling someone their own address
70:     is not a leak, and blanking it makes legitimate summaries read as broken.
71:     Everything else that looks like an identifier is redacted, because in a
72:     ticket summary it can only have come from another customer's record.
73:     """
74:     if not text:
75:         return text
76: 
77:     owners = _owner_keys(owner_identifiers)
78:     scrubbed = text
79: 
80:     for pii_type in ALWAYS_REDACT:
81:         pattern = PIIDetector.PATTERNS.get(pii_type)
82:         if pattern:
83:             scrubbed = re.sub(pattern, THIRD_PARTY_MARKER, scrubbed)
84: 
85:     for pii_type in OWNER_ONLY:
86:         pattern = PIIDetector.PATTERNS.get(pii_type)
87:         if not pattern:
88:             continue
89: 
90:         def _replace(match: re.Match) -> str:
91:             value = match.group()
92:             if value.lower() in owners or (_digits(value) and _digits(value) in owners):
93:                 return value
94:             return THIRD_PARTY_MARKER
95: 
96:         scrubbed = re.sub(pattern, _replace, scrubbed)
97: 
98:     if scrubbed != text:
99:         logger.warning(
100:             "Redacted third-party identifiers from an outbound ticket message"
101:         )
102:     return scrubbed

120: class HelpCenterHostMiddleware:
121:     """Pure-ASGI dispatcher installed inside the socketio wrapper: help-center
122:     hosts go to the public app, everything else to the main FastAPI app."""
123: 
124:     def __init__(self, app, public_app):
125:         self.app = app
126:         self.public_app = public_app
127: 
128:     async def __call__(self, scope, receive, send):
129:         if scope["type"] == "http":
130:             # Path dispatch (self-host default): /help/{slug}/... on the main
131:             # origin. Gated to path mode so cloud never serves the /help/ form.
132:             if settings.HELP_CENTER_PUBLIC_MODE == "path":
133:                 match = _HELP_PATH_RE.match(scope.get("path", ""))
134:                 if match:
135:                     slug = match.group(1)
136:                     # Drop a trailing slash from the remainder ourselves: letting
137:                     # Starlette's redirect_slashes handle it would 307 to a
138:                     # Location built from the rewritten (prefix-stripped) path,
139:                     # sending the visitor to the origin root without /help/{slug}.
140:                     remainder = (match.group(2) or "").rstrip("/") or "/"
141:                     scope["help_center"] = {"slug": slug, "base_path": f"/help/{slug}"}
142:                     scope["path"] = remainder
143:                     scope["raw_path"] = remainder.encode("latin-1")
144:                     await self.public_app(scope, receive, send)
145:                     return
